column3: Went to front early - pressed on and found extra approaching final furlong - dug in to prevail by a whisker
Tracked leader - pushed along inside final furlong - finished full of running to go down by a whisker
Held up from an awkward berth settling towards the back - travelling nicely though squeezed for space 2f out - pushed along with a furlong left - closed strongly late to be edging up at the line
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - boxed in approaching final furlong - stayed on to finish fourth beaten a length and a half
Held a midfield spot early - pushed along with 2f left and edged closer to the front group approaching the furlong pole - couldn't find more late finishing 5th
Hesitant start - held towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - eased right and stayed on late from inside the final furlong to finish sixth beaten 3.75 lengths
Stood up at the start and dropped towards the back - moved into contention behind the front group before 2f - pressed for effort with a furlong left - lost place close home to finish 7th
Sluggish start - settled near the back early - improved into contention after 2f - pressed for effort 2f out before fading fast approaching final furlong
Sat handy behind front group - pressed for effort then dropped away inside final 2f - eventually well held in 9th
Sluggish start - held up in the pack running wide - pushed along and dropped away 3f out
Settled off the pace early - moved through to challenge over 2f out before hitting the front with a furlong left - edged clear late to score
Went straight to front and dictated a measured tempo - given a squeeze approaching 3f out then urged again with 2f left - lost command a furlong from home - fought back gamely to finish second
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - moved right and stayed on through the last furlong - finished third beaten 4.5 lengths
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort from 2f out - stayed on same gear to finish 4th
Tracked pace-setter early - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground final furlong - finished 5th
Held up early after a slow break - stayed towards the back - pressed for effort with 2f left but couldn't land a blow - finished sixth well held
Set the pace from the off - pushed on into the advantage two furlongs out and soon opened a three-length margin - eased up in the closing stages - kept the chasing runner comfortably at bay to score
Settled midfield and wide of rivals - pushed along to close on leader over 2f out - stayed on strongly inside final furlong - narrowly held for second
Sat close to leader early - pushed along with 3f left - stayed on without finding extra from 2f out - finished third
Settled at the back early - moved into contention out wide with 2f left after being pressed for effort - unable to quicken final furlong - finished 4th
Held up at the back - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on without closing on the front group
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished sixth
Settled towards the rear early - pushed along with 3f left - dropped away steadily inside final 2f - eventually finished 7th
Settled towards rear early - moved into contention 3f out - sent to front 2f out - drew away in the last furlong to win
Set the tempo out front - pressed for effort and lost the advantage 2f out - responded gamely to take second
Settled off the pace early - pushed along to close in on the front group with 2f left - couldn't quicken in the last furlong - finished third
Sat close to the front group - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground inside the final furlong to finish fourth
Poor start and settled last - pushed along with 3f left - stayed on late for 5th
Held up towards back of field - pushed along with 2f left - unable to close and dropped away in the final furlong - finished sixth
Sat close to pace early - pushed along and lost ground fast approaching 3f out - dropped away to finish seventh
Settled behind the front-runner early - driven into control approaching 2f out and clear inside final furlong - kept on to score
Sluggish start - held towards back - pushed along a furlong out and finished strongly to just miss
Settled around midpack - progress checked with a furlong to run - pushed along and finished well to take third
Settled towards rear early - pushed along to close in with a furlong left - couldn't find more late on and finished fourth beaten 3 lengths
Settled midpack early - travelling smoothly with three furlongs left before being asked for effort - kept on at the same speed through the final furlong to finish fifth
Settled around midfield - pressed for effort with 2f left before angling right approaching the furlong marker - lost momentum close home to finish sixth
Checked early - held up towards the back - pushed along and made progress inside final furlong - stayed on to finish 7th beaten 4 lengths
Sluggish start - settled midfield - pushed along inside final furlong and unable to quicken late
Settled off the front rank - pushed along inside final furlong - stayed on same gear to finish 9th beaten 4½ lengths
Settled towards the back of the field - pushed along inside the final furlong - unable to land a blow - finished well beaten in 10th
Sluggish start - travelled wide and eager early - pushed along and dropped away 2f out - finished 11th
Set the pace early - pressed for effort and lost front spot approaching 2f out - dropped away fast inside the final furlong - finished 12th
Dwelt at the tail - roused into contention 3f out - gained ground with a furlong left - stayed on to hit the front on the line
Held up midpack - urged forward to reach the front pair approaching final furlong then went ahead close home - caught right on the line
Settled around midpack - asked for effort inside final 2f finding space to move through - stayed on approaching the last furlong - edged out for the finish to take third
Settled towards the back of the pack - pushed along with 2f left - surged to the front approaching the final furlong - overtaken soon after and dropped back late to finish fourth
Held third early - asked for effort over 2f out but couldn't close on front pair - stayed on at one gear through the last furlong to finish fifth
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - kept on at one effort late to finish sixth
Settled just off the pace early - hit the front after 4f and pushed along 2f out - lost momentum and gave up the advantage inside the final furlong
Set the pace early - lost the advantage but stayed in touch past halfway - pushed along 2f out then dropped away late
Handy early behind a fast tempo - tracking pacesetter into the straight - shaken up to hit the front a furlong out - drew away close home to score
Settled off the front-runners - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on inside final furlong to finish second
Sluggish start leaving group towards back - pushed along with 2f left - finished strongly to snatch third on the line
Settled around midpack - pushed along to close in on the front group approaching the final furlong - lost momentum close home - finished 4th
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - lost touch inside final furlong - finished 5th
Sprang to the front early - dictated a hot gallop out in front - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - lost position rapidly and passed inside the final furlong - trailed off to finish sixth
Held a midfield spot on the outer - pushed along 3f out - lost touch 2f out and eventually let up final furlong - finished well held in 7th
Sluggish start - dropped away with 4f left - well beaten at the finish
Held up towards the back - still 11th at halfway - began creeping into contention over 3f out - moved into second with a furlong left - hit the front close home - won going away
Sat second early - shared front spot after halfway - went in front 5f out - opened three lengths but drifted left approaching final furlong - overtaken close home yet kept battling to finish second
Sat behind the front group early - 4th at halfway - dropped back 3f out - rallied into second with a push 2f out - settled for third and held steady to the line

Keen to settle early - tucked up with the front group - 3rd at halfway - dropped to 5th with 5f left - pressed on approaching 3f out but couldn't find extra gear inside final furlong - stayed on at an even tempo to finish 4th

Made the running early - challenged for command after halfway then lost it 5f out - settled 2nd briefly before slipping to 3rd 3f out - down to 4th with no response to urging 1f out - finished off steadily in 5th
Sat close to the front pack early - 6th at halfway before dropping back approaching 4f out - down in 7th with 3f left - unable to make headway through the closing stages
Settled behind the front pack - back in 7th at halfway - made ground into 3rd with 4f left - slipped to 4th over 3f out - unable to threaten from 2f out - finished 7th
Held up at the back - 10th at halfway - crept into contention 5f from home - briefly up to 2nd with 3f left - dropped away inside the final 2f and faded
Sat close to front group early - dropped to 8th by halfway then 9th under pressure with 4f left - unable to close from 3f out and well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - still in ninth at halfway - dropped away 4f out - faded soon after - well beaten at the finish
Held up at the back from the start - lost touch six furlongs out - well beaten never featuring
Sat behind the pace early - 5th at halfway - up into 4th with 5f left - dropped away with 4f to go - well beaten before the finish - eased out of contention 1 1/2f out

Settled mid-pack early - made ground into contention by halfway - urged forward to move up to second turning for the last two furlongs - hit the front soon after and drifted slightly left approaching the final fence - stayed on well to prevail
Settled in the pack early - made progress into contention after 3 out - moved up to second 2 out - pressed the front-runner before the last but held on well without finding more late
Settled in the pack early - progress from 3 out - moved to press the front group before 2 out - up into third 2 out - blundered at the last but stayed on
Near the head of affairs early - eased back into the pack - asked for effort approaching three out - urged on before two out - moved into fourth after the last and stayed on to finish fourth

Held up in the pack - moved through to dispute second but blundered at the 3rd and 4th - under pressure approaching 3 out - left behind before the last and a serious error there ended any chance of fourth - faded into fifth
Sent straight to front and opened a big advantage - margin shortened after 3 out - overtaken approaching 2 out - dropped away quickly after and finished sixth
Held a forward spot early - clumsy over first then driven and slipped back on the turn before 2 out - well beaten before the last
Settled last from the off - never got involved - well beaten by the finish
Settled at the back early - lost touch soon after - well held for the remainder
Settled no closer than mid-pack early - lost touch three out - well beaten and finished last of all
Held up at the back - dropped away with no chance - stopped before 2 out and was pulled up
Settled towards the back early - pushed along and made ground 3f out - closed on the front group 2f out - moved into second entering the last furlong - stayed on to hit the front right on the line

Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early - up with the pace before going clear after 2f - urged along and challenged for the front 3f out - stayed on into the final furlong - edged in front through the last 110yds - caught in the closing strides
Handy early - driven approaching 3f out - dropped away 2f out - responded inside final 110yds to secure third but well held

Settled at the back early after fighting for control - pushed along and made progress from 3f out - still close enough entering the final 2f - stayed on to move up into fourth close home - never a threat to the leaders
Settled towards the back - made steady progress from 7f out - closed on the front-runner 3f from home - pushed along 2f out - dropped a place and faded before the line
Went straight to the front - overtaken before the 2f mark then pushed along and dropped back three out - faded late to finish sixth
Uneven pace through midpack early - lost touch and toiling past 6f - well beaten by 3f out - finished 7th
Settled in the pack early - pressed for effort 3f out and dropped away - well beaten at the finish
Fought for control early - handy with the pace before being pushed along and slipping back after 7f - well beaten by 3f out
Settled in the pack early - pushed along before halfway then slipped towards the back and toiling by 8f - well beaten from 3f out
Set the pace from the off - roused with two furlongs left - responded under pressure inside the final furlong - dug in through the closing stages to score
Settled close to the pace - asked for effort with 2f left - fought back strongly inside the final furlong - denied by a short margin
Held up at the back - urged into contention approaching final furlong - closed well late to grab third close home
Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early - tracked the pace near the front - pushed along approaching 2f out - responded briefly under pressure - faded near the finish to come home fourth
Settled in the pack - pushed along with over 2f left - failed to threaten leaders - kept on at one gait to finish 5th
Settled towards the back of the pack early - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground inside the final furlong - eventually finished sixth
Missed the break badly - trailed the field alone early - closed back onto the pack by the 4f marker but made no impression thereafter
Prominent early behind the front group - pushed along over 2f out - dropped away soon after - finished well held in 8th
Settled just behind the pace and pulling hard - urged along with 2f remaining - fought back in the final furlong and edged clear close home - got up right on the line to win
Sat behind the front group racing wide - moved through to the front 4f out - pushed clear approaching 2f out - battled and kept going hard in the last furlong - caught right on the line
Settled towards the back - pushed along and made steady headway inside the final furlong - closing well to finish third beaten 5.5 lengths
Settled towards rear early - pushed along to close on front group approaching 2f out - lost momentum inside final furlong - finished 4th beaten 7 lengths
Settled towards the rear of the pack - pushed along under pressure with 2f left - stayed on without gaining ground inside the final furlong - finished fifth
Settled midpack early - bumped and lost touch with over 2f to run - pushed along and stayed on same gear from the final furlong - finished sixth beaten 8.5 lengths
Settled towards rear early - boxed in and knocked about 3f out - pushed along 2f out and stayed on same gear to finish 7th
Poor start - held up at the back throughout - never involved - finished eighth
Sluggish beginning - fought hard against restraint early - stayed at the back of the field throughout - finished ninth well beaten
Went straight to front - travelled a bit fresh and drifted right approaching the turn after 1f - lost command with 4f remaining - dropped away in a hurry 2f out to finish well beaten

Sluggish start settling towards the back - mistake at the 9th - made progress into contention by the 13th - moved into second spot approaching 3 out - cruising smoothly to lead before 2 out - opened up a commanding advantage before the last - allowed to ease down on the run-in - scored comfortably
Settled third - serious error at the fourth last disrupted progress but recovered to press the front before 2 out - stuck on without ever threatening the winner and well beaten into second
Up with the pace early - in front after the 2nd - surrendered the lead at the 6th - driven after 4 out and soon left behind - faded from the last to finish 3rd
Sluggish start - dropped into last and well behind by the 4th - inherited fourth spot 2 out but well held at the finish
Sent to front early - lost advantage after 2nd then regained control by 6th - hit the deck at the 12th - driven up 4 out - lost the lead before 3 out - drifted right and came down 2 out
Settled in the pack early - blundered at the 11th and slipped to the rear by three out - beaten a long way and eased out of it before two out
Pulled hard early - tracked the pace - pressed for effort 2f from home - moved through to the front inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Sluggish start - settled mid-pack - urged forward 3f out - closing on the front group 2f out - improved into second inside the final furlong but unable to reel in the winner
Pulled hard early - went straight to front - pressed for effort with 2f left - overtaken inside final furlong - lost momentum late - just about kept third
Settled in the pack early - urged forward 3f out - made progress approaching final furlong - stayed on to the line without threatening the leaders - finished fourth beaten just over five lengths
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 3f left and close to the front pair with 2f to run - faded in the final furlong to finish fifth
Fought for control early - travelled close to the front - pressed for effort 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong - faded to finish sixth
Settled at back of field - pushed along with 2f left - unable to close final furlong - finished 7th
Sluggish start - never a factor - finished 8th beaten well over 11 lengths
Settled third early - pushed along to hit the front a furlong out - opened up from the field in the closing stages - kept going comfortably to the line

Set the pace early - lost front spot but stayed close after 2f - pushed along approaching final two furlongs - responded and stayed on through the last furlong - held for second beaten just over a length
Settled towards the back of the pack early - asked for effort with 2f left - responded well to take third close home

Sat just behind pace early - went in front approaching 3f out - pushed along a furlong out - swiftly overtaken - stayed on approaching final furlong - weakened near line - dropped a place late to finish 4th
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on same pace inside the final furlong
Sluggish start - settled towards the back of the pack - pushed along with 2f left - kept going at one speed late to finish sixth
Held up towards the back from the off - pulled hard - stayed there for much of the trip - finished seventh
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished eighth
Sat close to pace early - pushed along with 2f left - moved to front inside final furlong - kept going to prevail by a whisker
Settled off the pace early - pressed forward into contention over a furlong out - finished strongly to go down by a whisker
Sluggish start - held up towards the back - progress into contention 2f out - driven along and finished strongly from inside the final furlong despite being squeezed for space late
Sluggish start - hustled into midfield - travelling nicely by 2f out - shifted course and urged along - stayed on late but held for 4th
Tracked the front group early - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on at one speed inside the final furlong - finished 5th
Settled midpack and racing wide - moved up to challenge in front 3f out - kicked clear 2f out - overtaken and lost momentum inside final furlong
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on same gear from the final furlong - finished seventh
Held a midfield spot early - pushed along and racing wide with 2f left before finishing steadily to the line
Held up in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to land a blow - finished well held
Held up towards back of field - travelled wide throughout - pushed along but unable to close from over 1f out - well held in 10th
Slow into stride - held up towards the back throughout - never a threat - well held in 11th
Sent clear early holding keen rein - lost front spot under pressure 2f out - dropped away fast final furlong to finish 12th
Settled at the back early - improving into contention 3 out - hit the front 2 out - pulled away impressively after the last to win comfortably
Settled in third early - moved up behind the front pair before the second last then into second after the final fence - stayed on to finish runner-up beaten two and a half lengths
Settled in second early - blundered three out - driven approaching two out - awkward again at the last - lost placings on the run to the line
Went straight to the front and dictated a modest gallop - lost command approaching two out - dropped away before the final fence to finish fourth
Settled in fourth early - urged forward after three out - lost touch with the front group - clipped the second-last and dropped well behind before the final fence
Held up at the back - lost more ground after a poor leap 3rd - well behind from 3 out - finished a distant 6th
Sat close to the pace - pushed to the front inside the final furlong - finished strongly to score
Settled mid-pack early - moved through field 2f out to challenge for second - closed on leader inside final furlong - stayed on but unable to get past
Sat close to the front pack early - pushed along inside the final furlong - kept going without finding extra - finished third
Handy in the pack early - hit the front two out then pushed along and lost that advantage inside the final furlong - dropped away in the closing stages to finish fourth
Held mid-pack early - nudged for effort 2f out - unable to quicken and finished well held in 5th
Settled at the back early - urged forward two furlongs out - edged into it late but made little headway - finished sixth well beaten
Settled towards the back early - pushed along with 2f left - no impression made and finished 7th
Set the pace early - driven for effort inside the last two furlongs and lost the advantage - dropped away quickly after - finished well beaten in 8th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with a furlong left - dropped away quickly after - finished well off the pace in 9th
Settled around mid-pack - pressed for a run 2f out - had little left and dropped away - finished 10th
Settled at the back early - pushed along with 2f left - unable to land a blow through to the line
Set the pace early - lost the front but stayed in touch after 2f - driven back to the front approaching the final furlong - pulled clear with ease - won going away
Handy early - pushed along a furlong out - lost ground to rival up front - stayed on inside final furlong to finish second beaten 3.5 lengths
Held up in the pack - pushed along and made progress a furlong out - stayed on strongly to grab third close home
Settled close to the pace early - hit the front approaching 2f - overtaken inside the last furlong - dropped back late to finish fourth
Held up at rear - pushed along over a furlong out - edged past faders late to finish fifth
Took a strong hold early - settled midpack through the race - roused approaching final furlong - stayed on at one gear to finish sixth beaten 6.75 lengths
Sat handy early - pushed along approaching 2f out - dropped away final furlong - finished 7th
Held up towards the back of the pack early - never got competitive and stayed there through to the finish - well held in 8th
Settled off the pace early - moved through on the outer approaching 2f out then went on with a burst over a furlong out - drew away inside the closing stages to score
Settled off the front pack - pressed for effort with a furlong left - finished strongly to take second
Settled off the pace - pushed along with 2f left - finished strongly late to grab third
Sat behind pacesetter - pushed along with 2f left - kept plugging on same gear from the final furlong - finished 4th
Set the early gallop and went clear in front - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - overtaken approaching the final furlong - lost momentum late to finish fifth
Settled off the pace early - pressed for effort 2f out - unable to quicken final furlong - finished sixth
Held up early after a check - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on at same effort from the final furlong to finish seventh
Held up towards back of field - pushed along with 2f left - unable to close on front pack - finished well held in 8th
Settled in the pack - pushed along and dropped away with 2f left - finished ninth well held
Held up at the back - pressed along and losing touch over 2f out - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack - pushed along and dropped away fast with 2f left - well held at the finish

Settled up with the pace early - drifted back through midfield 3 out - rallied approaching 2 out - into 4th before the last - rider briefly adrift in the saddle over the run-in - rallied to challenge in 2nd - hit the front inside the final furlong and a half - kept finding more to the line

Settled behind the front pack early - lost footing a touch after the 3rd - error four out dropped back to 6th before making headway three out - into 4th and pushed out before two out - down to 5th with nothing to offer approaching last - rallied on the run-in - grabbed second right at the line
Handy early - up in second from early stages - hit front two out - slim edge approaching last - overtaken inside final furlong and a half - finished third without further response
Tracked front group early - 7th four out and 6th by two out - unable to close before last - stayed on at one tempo to finish 4th

Went straight to the front - blundered and lost the advantage 2 out - tight up in third approaching the last - pushed alongside in the straight but couldn't find more inside the final furlong and a half

Up with the front group - made a small error 4 out and was 5th - moved through to 3rd before 2 out - jumped to 2nd and disputed the lead momentarily over the last - dropped back to 4th and found nothing more - faded to finish 6th
Held up at back of field - pushed along by the 4th - trailed at the tail before 3 out - never a threat and losing touch 2 out - pulled up before the last
Held up at the back throughout - lost touch three out - eased and pulled up before the final fence
Sat close to the front pack early - third with four to jump - dropped away after three out - faded from contention - eased down and pulled up before the final fence
Towards the back of the field - smooth progress from 14th - swept to the front 2 out - pushed along and overtaken at the last - fought back to assert on the run-in

Settled towards the back early - blundered heavily 15th - a lot of ground to recover before improving 3 out - into third spot 2 out - stumbled but edged in front last - overtaken soon after and stayed on without finding more late
Settled in second early - moved to front at the 8th before slipping back to third - fell away 12th - recovered to press at the front from 3f out - one-paced after the last to finish third
Went straight to front - shown up 8th before edged in front again then overtaken for good 14th - dropped away rounding turn after 3 out - found fresh energy late to claim fourth
Held up in the pack - driven approaching 3 out - shuffled back 2 out - dropped away after the last to finish fifth
Race close to pace early - moved into second after 11th - hit front 14th but scratchy over next fence - shaken up when overtaken 2 out - dropped away sharply after last to finish sixth
Held up towards the back - lost touch before 2 out - well held by the finish
Settled on the far flank early - tracking the pacesetter - eased forward to hit the front approaching 2f out - drifted right under pressure inside the final furlong - stayed on gamely to score

Settled towards the back near the near rail - travelling comfortably with two furlongs left - pushed along and made progress from the final furlong - moved into second inside the last 110 yards - closed strongly to be edged out at the line
Settled in mid-pack down the middle - asked for effort with 2f left - moved up on the leader inside the final furlong - stayed on at one tempo - edged out of second close to home - finished third
Settled early on the far rail - hit front early on - pressed for effort and lost advantage 2f out - stayed on at one gear through the last furlong to finish fourth beaten 3.75L
Held a spot through the middle - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on late to finish 5th beaten 4 lengths
Settled in the pack near the stands rail - boxed in with 2f left - eased across left and pushed along inside final furlong - stayed on without threatening - finished sixth beaten 4¼ lengths
Settled towards the stands rail in the pack - pushed along with 3f left - nudged into contention entering the last furlong - unable to add to that late and finished 7th
Settled on the near flank early - hit the front - pressed for effort with 2f left - overtaken inside final furlong and faded late
Settled towards the back through the middle stretch - pushed along with two furlongs left - stayed on late but never a threat - finished 9th beaten 7 lengths
Settled at the back near the stands rail - pushed along when boxed in with 2f left - stayed on through the final furlong - never a threat late on

Sluggish start - settled mid-track towards the back - eased across left and pressed for effort 2f out - found a bit of extra momentum entering the final furlong - stayed on at an even effort to finish 11th
Settled up with the pace on the near flank - pressed for effort with 2f left - faded in the closing furlong to finish 12th
Settled midfield in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong to finish well held
Bumped at the start - travelled on the near flank in the pack - restrained in mid-division - pushed along with 2f left - shifted left soon after - unable to make ground in the closing stages
Held a spot on the near rail early - up with the pace - pressed for effort 2f out then dropped away quickly
Slow to break - settled midpack down the middle - pushed along with 2f left - unable to close final furlong
Held a middle position early - hit front and pushed along over 2f out - soon overtaken and dropped away to finish 17th
Held a spot in the middle group early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong to finish well held
Bumped into at the off - settled towards the back - kept up along the stand rail - pushed along with 2f left - eased over to the left - lost ground in the closing stages
Settled towards the pack on the near rail - pushed along 3f out - faded inside final furlong to finish well held
Settled in the pack down the middle of the track - pushed along with over 2f left - lost ground final furlong to finish well held
Drifted left at the off - settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f to go - lost ground inside final furlong - well held at the finish
Settled towards rear from the off - never a factor - well held in 23rd
drifted right early - tracked the pace on the near rail - pushed along 3f out - dropped away 2f out to finish 24th
Handy in the pack early - urged forward passing the 2f marker - hit front soon after - lost lead approaching final furlong - fought back inside it and found extra close home - won going away
Settled mid-pack - pressed for effort 2f out - found extra inside final furlong to close - kept going to the line but narrowly denied
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along inside final furlong - stayed on to grab third close home
mid-pack early - angled left to find room and pushed up to challenge in front approaching 2f out - hit the front briefly inside the final furlong - overtaken soon after - faded to finish fourth
Handy near front - urged along with 2f left and closed on the pacesetter - lost momentum close home to finish 5th beaten 2 1/4 lengths
Held up towards the back - pushed along with two furlongs left and made progress inside the final furlong - couldn't quicken again and finished sixth
held towards the back of the pack early - stayed there with little impact - finished well held in 7th
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - went to the front - lost the advantage over 2f out - faded into the pack finishing well held
Held up at the back - unable to get involved - finished ninth beaten 7 1/4 lengths
Sat behind the front group early - up to 6th and hit the fence three out - made ground to be second last two - fought back approaching the last - got up in the final strides to score

Settled behind the front group early - moved into 4th 4 out - up to 2nd soon after - hit the front after 2 out and held a slim edge over the last - kept battling to the line but caught in the final strides - just denied
Sat behind the front group - mid-pack 4 out - made headway 3 out - up to 5th 2 out - 4th before last unable to threaten - rallied to grab 3rd near the finish
Set the pace early - lost the front two out and held tight to the podium spots at the last - couldn't find more late and finished fourth
Sat close behind pace - third with 4 to jump - dropped away after 2 out and finished well held
Handy early up with the pace in 3rd - dropped to 5th 4 out then 4th 3 out - bumped 2 out - faded from there - never able to threaten - finished well beaten in 6th
Settled in second early behind the pace - dropped back after 4 out - fading into 8th with 3 to jump - well beaten from there - finished last of all
Tracked the pace-setters - up to 6th 4 out - within striking distance in 5th when came down 2 out
Settled towards the back early - lost touch before 3 out - eased and pulled up before 2 out
Held up in the pack - never a threat - eased out of contention before the second-last
Held up towards the back early - midfield around 4 out - unable to find headway before 3 out - lost touch and pulled up before the last
Needed urging early - anchored at the rear throughout with no impact - eased out of contention before 2 out
Settled just behind pace early - closed on the front-runner by the 10th - went in front approaching two out - driven out after the last to hold on gamely
Settled in third - minor error at the 2nd - moved to second at the last - pressed the winner on the run-in - faded late to finish second
